basic_info.description: Beautifully refreshed home in the heart of Bay view , offering a blend of comfort, convenience, and value. Recent upgrades include fresh interior paint, brand-new carpet, and thoughtful improvements throughout. The property features a bright, open layout with great natural light, a private outdoor space ideal for relaxing or entertaining, and an attached garage for added convenience. Located on a quiet residential street with close proximity to public transit, 3rd Street corridor shops and dining, and neighborhood parks. This is a fantastic opportunity for buyers looking to establish themselves in one of San Francisco’s fastest-growing communities.
